tasks.label: All Playwright tests (.env.dev)
tasks.command: export $(grep -E '^(POSTGRES_USER|POSTGRES_PASSWORD|POSTGRES_DB)=' ../../../../../.env.dev | sed 's/"/\\"/g') && POSTGRES_HOST=localhost POSTGRES_PORT=5442 npx playwright test

tasks.label: Current Playwright test file (.env.dev)
tasks.command: export $(grep -E '^(POSTGRES_USER|POSTGRES_PASSWORD|POSTGRES_DB)=' ../../../../../.env.dev | sed 's/"/\\"/g') && POSTGRES_HOST=localhost POSTGRES_PORT=5442 npx playwright test "${file}"
